interface.longDescription: fp-init sets up docs/ and the fp rules in AGENTS.md. think-deep settles fuzzy ideas, create-prd writes requirements, architect writes design docs, check-impact finds what a change could break, unslop cleans prose, and learn records lessons. Linear-aware.
